note: Offline behavioural eval. Run: uv run evals/grade.py (or python3 evals/grade.py -- the skill is stdlib-only). Exits non-zero on any failure. Fixtures are trimmed real payloads captured 2026-08-05 and live in scripts/tests/fixtures; no network is used. These assert the behaviours whose absence would be SILENT -- a source returning fewer rows, a duplicate quietly dropped, a rate limit forgotten -- rather than the ones that would crash loudly.

evals.name: schema-drift-rejects-wholesale
evals.asserts: a payload missing a required key yields status=degraded, zero rows, and a reason naming the field -- never a partial parse, which would read as a quiet day

evals.name: healthy-fixtures-pass-their-own-schema
evals.asserts: every one of the eight real fixtures validates against its declared key set, so the drift guard cannot fire on healthy data

evals.name: dedupe-collapses-cross-source
evals.asserts: the same posting from two boards with different location text collapses to one row and records also_seen_on

evals.name: dedupe-preserves-distinct-cities
evals.asserts: the same title at the same company in two different cities stays two rows -- these are separate applications

evals.name: first-seen-survives-refetch
evals.asserts: re-inserting a known job updates last_seen and leaves first_seen untouched

evals.name: undated-rows-are-kept
evals.asserts: a row with no posted_at survives the window filter, because three sources publish no dates and a naive filter would delete them silently

evals.name: ratelimit-fails-closed
evals.asserts: a missing ratelimit.json for a previously-polled source refuses the poll rather than assuming it never happened

evals.name: backpressure-is-not-failure
evals.asserts: HTTP 429 yields status=throttled and records a backoff, so the next run waits instead of retrying into the same wall

evals.name: report-escapes-hostile-input
evals.asserts: a title containing a script tag and a company containing both quote characters render escaped; the document holds exactly one script tag and no unquoted attributes

evals.name: attribution-is-present
evals.asserts: a report containing a Remote OK row carries a dofollow remoteok.com link, which is a condition of API access

evals.name: report-is-self-contained-and-deterministic
evals.asserts: no external asset references, and two renders of identical input are byte-identical

evals.name: contacts-stripped-at-ingest
evals.asserts: no email address survives normalisation of any real fixture

evals.name: unplaced-rows-are-counted-not-dropped
evals.asserts: a stored row with no location survives the Store round trip and is counted under its own label, because a breakdown that silently omits rows has the same failure shape as the bug it exists to expose
